TEXT.English: Native Guerilla

Birthplace origin: +5 withdrawal on hills or peaks. Granted to eligible units produced in a qualifying city; cannot be selected with experience. Unlocks the corresponding level I promotion. The origin and its bonus remain with later ranks.
Effect - Native Guerilla

Automatically present while Combat - Native Promotions is enabled and at least four of the nine tiles in the city-centered 3x3 area are hills or peaks. The center tile is included; ownership and worked status do not matter. Each Native effect qualifies independently. Newly produced eligible units receive Native Guerilla. Visiting units receive nothing; existing units are not retroactively given an origin.
Requires at least four matching tiles within one tile of the city, including the center. Grants Native Guerilla to newly produced eligible units only.

Combat - Native Promotions

Cities automatically gain each Native effect supported by at least four matching tiles in their centered 3x3 area, including the center. Eligible units produced there receive the corresponding Native origin and +5 withdrawal on its matching terrain or features. Several origins may be granted. Visitors receive none. Origins cannot be selected with experience and unlock the corresponding level I promotion; their bonuses remain at higher ranks. If the Battlefield Promotions BUG option is enabled, a battlefield level I reward also grants its Native origin. Existing units are not assigned origins from their current positions; existing promotions are preserved.
